nina_sales: Quick pre-call checklist for EdgeFlow POC tomorrow 10:30 PDT. Customer asks: SAML for Dedicated, stream retry/backpressure behavior (they have a mutating proxy), and an example pricing scenario for short high-volume bursts. Who can own each?

sam_engineering: I can own the tech bits. SAML + SCIM flows are supported on Dedicated via the Console. Typical steps: upload IdP metadata -> test idp-initiated login -> enable SCIM for user sync. I'll prepare a 1-page runbook.

omar_infra: Note: if they choose Private/on-prem theres an extra infra license + optional air-gapped packaging. For VPC peering we need customer firewall to allow outbound TLS to control-plane hosts and we use mTLS for agent connections. I'll add a VPC checklist.

jenna_solutions: Streaming/backpressure details: SDKs send newline-delimited JSON frames. Server emits control frames when overloaded: `{ "type":"control","code":503,"reason":"backpressure" }`  SDKs interpret that and do an exponential backoff retry. For long-lived sessions recommend ephemeral stream tokens (TTL ~10m) and client-side seq ids so streams can resume. Example quick curl for the POC:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEM" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"model":"rwd/stream-small","input":"healthcheck"}'
```

jenna_solutions: Node sample (ws):

```
const ws = new WebSocket(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('msg', JSON.parse(m)));
ws.on('close', () => console.log('closed'));
```

jenna_solutions: For tool/function calls and structured outputs use our FuncJSON schema. For POC start with a tiny schema: `{ "type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"},"payload":{"type":"object"}}}`  SDK validates and raises `tool_call` events your handler can consume.

kate_se: Security questions: we support BYOK via KMS integrations on Dedicated/Private (customer-managed CMKs or Hashi Vault). We'll need to provide SOC2 artifact list, encryption-at-rest notes, and console MFA enforcement docs. Also confirm retention limits for telemetry.

nina_sales: Pricing ask: they want reserved 50rps with occasional spikes to 300rps for 5-15 minutes. How to illustrate costs simply?

sam_engineering: Reserved covers baseline capacity. Excess usage falls to on-demand/burst pricing which is priced per-GPU-minute/token with an uplift (roughly 1.5-2x on-demand vs reserved rate; exact figures come from acct mgmt). We can offer a small pre-bought burst-credit pool to smooth costs for short spikes. I'll draft a one-slide example comparing: reserved-only, reserved+burst-credit, and pure on-demand.

omar_infra: Operational caveat: very short high spikes can hit concurrency limits on model variants; recommend a failover plan (fallback to smaller model or queueing) to keep p99 latency reasonable.

jenna_solutions: POC run steps suggestion: 1) Provision Dedicated test tenant + enable SAML test IdP; 2) Issue ephemeral stream tokens; 3) Run the curl & Node WS checks; 4) Switch to FuncJSON tool flow with 2 sample schemas; 5) Capture Console traces + cost sample and share.

kate_se: I'll pull SOC2 artifact summary and KMS integration note and drop into this thread before EOD.

deploybot: Heads up: control-plane deploy tonight at 23:00 UTC. No expected disruptions to existing Dedicated tenants; ephemeral token issuance remains available.

nina_sales: Perfect. I'll attach the customer's security questionnaire and the calendar invite. @sam_engineering @jenna_solutions please have the runbook + sample code snippets ready for the call. :thumbsup:
